DEC-002.title: Use dist.all_gather_object in get_checkpoint_state + world_size stamp in checkpoint for streaming resume fix
DEC-002.rationale: Rank-0-only save drops non-zero rank shard cursors causing silent retrain from line 0 on resume. Moving collect_extra_state before the rank==0 gate makes the all_gather collective run on all ranks (avoids deadlock). world_size stamp lets resume reject cross-layout checkpoints where shard arithmetic (line_idx % num_shards) diverges.
DEC-002.alternatives_rejected: (1) save per-rank checkpoint files: rejected — breaks existing rank-0-only CheckpointManager save path; (2) skip world_size check: rejected — silent data duplication/drop is worse than an explicit error)
